hypothesis: Jerome (call of 19 Oct 2026, 01:16-01:20) asked for the networks to be trained the standard way (denoising score matching, 'standard DDPM is fine') and for one comparison at a time: an estimator that knows the structure against a CNN that does not. E33 trained its networks on ONE fixed noisy copy per sequence and only at M = 128 and 2048. With the standard recipe (fresh level and fresh noise for every clean sequence at every step) the CNN gets more information than EM-BP, so it is the network-favourable baseline. The paper's three-way comparison on the field (site energy, MDN kernel inside BP, CNN) rests on it.
design: E33's six cells x M in (32, 128, 512, 2048) x seeds 0-7. One arm: the window CNN with E33's per-cell winning hyper-parameters (outputs/hpc_E33n_s0/winners.json; radius 2/4/8 at h = 1/0.5/0.25, width 64), trained by `nn_torch.train(loss='dsm')` on the E33 training chains (rng_for('e33-train', seed, cell, M)), eps parameterisation, a fresh level from the twelve-level schedule and fresh noise per sequence per step, batch 64, Adam 1e-3, gradient clip 1, 64k steps, checkpoints 500-64000 (doubled from E33's 32k because the dev fit below ended at the 32k cap). Checkpoint chosen on the validation bundle's BP risk (the rule of the kernel arms' `risk` rows). Scored on E33's test bundle: `e33._common` builds the bundles from the same generator keys, so `test_bundle` hashes equal E33's and every comparison is paired by seed.

predeclared_predictions.P1: The standard DSM CNN beats E33's one-corruption DSM CNN (same architecture and hyper-parameters) at M = 128 and M = 2048 on every cell (12 cell-M pairs), in at least 7 of 8 seeds each.
predeclared_predictions.P2: The site energy (E33 em_pair_quartic, risk-selected) beats the standard DSM CNN at every cell and every M (24 pairs), in at least 7 of 8 seeds each.
predeclared_predictions.P3: Data efficiency: the site energy's seed-mean risk at M = 32 is below the standard CNN's seed-mean risk at M = 2048 on at least 4 of the 6 cells.
predeclared_predictions.P4: The MDN kernel inside BP (E33 em_mdn, risk-selected) has a lower seed-mean risk than the standard CNN at M = 2048 on at least 5 of 6 cells.
predeclared_predictions.P5: At M = 32 the standard CNN has a lower seed-mean risk than the MDN kernel on at least 3 of 6 cells.
predeclared_predictions.P6: The standard CNN's seed-mean risk falls strictly with M (32 < 128 < 512 < 2048) on every cell.

predeclared_analysis: tools/core/read_e54.py: per (cell, M) the seed means of risk for dsm_standard (this run), dsm_one_corruption/window (E33 hpc_E33n_s*), em_pair_quartic (hpc_E33q_s*) and em_mdn (hpc_E33k_s*), risk-selected rows only, seeds 0-7, paired by (cell, seed, M) after asserting equal test_bundle hashes; win counts per pair; the at_cap share per (cell, M) printed beside every verdict (an at-cap CNN is an upper bound). A failed or missing fit counts against every prediction it touches.
